chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Torah was revealed during the six nights that passed from the month of Ramadan, and the Gospel was revealed during the twelve nights that passed from the month of Ramadan, and the Psalms were revealed on the eighteenth night that passed from the month of Ramadan, and the Quran was revealed on the Night of Decree.

key_terms.لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ: The Night of Decree/Power, associated with the revelation of the Quran

ai.seo_question: On which nights of Ramadan were the Torah, Gospel, Psalms, and Quran revealed?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi establishes a hierarchical chronology of divine revelation, positioning the Quran's descent on Laylat al-Qadr as the culmination of previous scriptures revealed earlier in Ramadan. Shia scholars utilize this hadith to emphasize the unique status of the Quran as the final and preserved revelation, contrasting it with the Torah, Gospel, and Psalms. It reinforces the theological significance of Laylat al-Qadr as the night of ultimate guidance and the completion of the prophetic message.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The Torah was Revealed during the 6<sup>th</sup> night from a Month of Ramazan, and the Evangel was Revealed during the 12<sup>th</sup> night of a Month of Ramazan, and the Psalms were Revealed during the 18<sup>th</sup> night of a Month of Ramazan, and the Quran was Revealed during the Night of Predetermination’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn abu Hamzah from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

Torah was revealed during the sixth night of the month of Ramadan. Injil (New Testament) was revealed during the twelfth night of the month of Ramadan. Al-Zabbur, (Psalms) was revealed during the eighteenth night of the month of Ramadan; and the Holy Quran was revealed during the night of destiny.’”
